_about: Public-domain Mandell Creighton (1843-1901), church historian and Bishop of London, for the Word Hoard: A History of the Papacy during the Period of the Reformation (1882-1894, five volumes), Persecution and Tolerance, the Hulsean Lectures (1895), and The Church and the Nation, his charges and addresses edited by Louise Creighton (1901), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
